corpus.cache_policy: The runner MAY use a local immutable cache keyed by commit and sha256. It MUST verify sha256 before parsing and MUST fail the vector rather than fetch a moving branch or accept a digest mismatch.

assertions: every matching crypto-basics, key-schedule, message, welcome, and TreeKEM case reproduces the corpus bytes exactly
the runner verifies every file digest before parsing or executing a case
missing corpus, network failure without a verified cache, digest mismatch, skipped matching case, or unsupported field fails the vector
the runner records the corpus commit, file digests, matching case count, and implementation artifact digest as evidence
